svg.aria-label: Persistent memory: Gives AI coding agents persistent memory. The memory survives the session. One index, one file: Indexes your codebase into one SQLite file, context.db. Agents query file roles, exports and dependents. Fewer tokens in real agent runs: On import-graph questions (683-file fixture, n=5) it used 28-47 % fewer uncached tokens (GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek v4 pro; DeepSeek cost -29 %) at equal or better success, every repeat above 0. With Claude Code (Opus) on two tasks it used more. The 43.7 % figure is simulated: see the benchmark in 04 USAGE. A sprint process: Runs a full sprint process for a 9-agent team: vision, discovery, milestones, epics, tickets, gates and retros. It uses 97 MCP tools and 6 slash commands. A live dashboard: Shows everything on a live React dashboard at :3333. Zero API keys
